a.speaker: buck
a.text: Don't... don't hurt the dogs. They only ever did what I taught 'em.

b.speaker: cass
b.text: Who told you to keep the lane clear?

c.speaker: buck
c.text: Call came from the production office. Same voice that calls you, I'd bet. Smooth. Polite. Pays in cash.

d.speaker: narration
d.text: Behind her, forty dogs go quiet at once.

s1.speaker: cass
s1.text: Open the pens, Buck. Let's see who they follow.

s2.speaker: narration
s2.text: The dogs walk straight past her. Every one of them. They lie down around him and won't let anybody near.
